text: Assumption: Concurrent calls shall be serialized by the caller — is this correct?

norm: concurrent calls shall be serialized by the caller
assumption: Concurrent calls shall be serialized by the caller.
rationale: The specification designates the function as Non Reentrant, but does not specify any instance-related concurrency.
